note: Ground truth for the board committee seats a DEF 14A proxy statement states, per director, on 27 filings from the 2026 proxy season. Two kinds of fixture, named by `truth`. `text-cited` (14 filings): every seat was read off the filing's text and carries the 1-based line of converter.py's output for the filing (line-identical to the authors' converter) and a verbatim quote from that line; the quotes were checked mechanically against the text. `verified-reading` (13 filings whose roster is a membership matrix): the seats were read from the table's HTML by a dedicated model pass and verified against hand-counted seats and chairs per committee, with spot checks by hand; they carry no line or quote. `slate` lists the directors standing for election; a seat whose director is not on the slate belongs to a director the filing says is leaving and is scored separately. `imageSeats` are seats the filing states only in a picture. `futureRoles` are roles the filing states as taking effect at or after the meeting.
